source_caveat: The page gives no EMA lengths, no Donchian length, no stop, no target, no cost and leaves its filters undefined. Every number below is a conventional default fixed here before any return was computed; nothing was fitted to the page's reported results.
policy: One canonical spec per strategy, no grid, no tuning after performance. Same windows, costs, data and IS gate as the base config. OOS and FWD are read only for IS-gate passers.

s7_multiday_ema_cross.page_rule: 15-minute bars, full NYMEX session 18:00-17:00, long when the fast EMA crosses above the slow EMA, short when below, positions held across sessions; unnamed pattern filters
s7_multiday_ema_cross.execution: always in the market after warm-up; reverse at the open of the first 1m bar after the 15m close that shows the cross
s7_multiday_ema_cross.roll_cost: one extra round trip charged at each contract roll while in position
s7_multiday_ema_cross.metrics: daily mark-to-market by trading day (18:00 ET roll); degraded-quality days are not removed because positions span them
s7_multiday_ema_cross.topstep_note: holds overnight and over weekends, which Topstep does not allow

s8_intraday_donchian.page_rule: 15-minute bars, Donchian channel on the highest high / lowest low of N periods, positions held a few hours; undefined volatility, time and trend filters
s8_intraday_donchian.channel: highest high and lowest low of the last 20 closed 15m bars (full Globex session)
s8_intraday_donchian.entry: stop order one tick beyond the channel, 09:00-14:00 ET, first breakout of the day only
s8_intraday_donchian.exit: trailing stop on the opposite channel side (ratchets only in favour of the trade), else flatten at the last core bar; no target
s8_intraday_donchian.filters: none (undefined on the page); no entries 10:00-11:00 ET on EIA Wednesdays as in the base config
